$comment: Source catalogue. FR-I18N-8: no user-facing string is hard-coded anywhere in the codebase. Voice rules from readme.md apply to every value here — sentence case except the uppercase eyebrow layer, second person for the shopper, imperative for actions, no exclamation marks, no emoji. Errors name the object and the fix. Empty states are one line and one action.
